title: Requeijão caseiro
creator: eubetoalmeida
statusNote: The caption gives ingredients only. The steps are the usual method for homemade requeijão.
steps: Heat 1 litre of milk until almost boiling, turn off the heat and stir in the vinegar. Let it curdle.
Strain the curds and discard the whey.
Blend the curds with 1 cup of milk, the butter and salt until smooth and creamy.
Warm briefly in a pan, stirring, then transfer to a jar and chill.
